title: 2.5.8 Catch Your First Error
description: Write a try...catch that falls back gracefully when a variable doesn't exist, and confirm the program still finishes. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Attempt the risky read
steps.instructions: Write a try block that uses console.log to print a variable called username. Never declare username anywhere in this file.

steps.title: Fall back in catch
steps.instructions: In the catch block, use console.log to print exactly "Falling back to Guest".

steps.title: Confirm the program continues
steps.instructions: After the whole try...catch block, use console.log to print exactly "Welcome!" and confirm it still appears when you run the code.

requirements.title: try/catch present
requirements.description: Code contains a try block and a catch block

requirements.title: reads username inside try
requirements.description: The try block logs a variable called username

requirements.title: Welcome! logged after the block
requirements.description: Welcome! is logged after the catch block closes
